title: Reasoning Over Recall: Evaluating the Efficacy of Generalist Architectures vs. Specialized Fine-Tunes in RAG-Based Mental Health Dialogue Systems
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the technical performance, empathy, and clinical safety of LLMs in mental health counseling. While it includes a standard 'Ethics Approval' section and measures safety (e.g., avoiding dangerous advice), it does not benchmark or evaluate religion, faith, or ethical/moral philosophy as a core component of its research.
